$note: Soul Lane 3 — Hero archetypes. All archetypes are DESIGN PROPOSAL. Each binds a hero HeroId to a progression doctrine via a read-only data table (FSoulHeroArchetypeTable); no new runtime struct field required. Archetypes bias STARTING skills and recommended domains; they do NOT hard-lock the TMap<FName,int32> Skills — a player may still invest cross-domain. Compatible with current four-faction game and the Hero/Paragon kind distinction (VERIFIED: ESoulHeroKind in SoulHero.h).

human_founder_hero.start: Level 1, UnspentSkillPoints 1, MaxMana 80, Mana 80, KnownSpells {Magic.Spell.Fire.Firebolt} (Firebolt is RESET in Heartland profile), affinity Frost/primary from HeartlandDevelopment.json

dwarf_king_commander.source: DwarfCommander FSoulHeroState; Heartland non-player commander; gates siege via CanCommandSiege

rowan.source: CompanionStatus(): 'Rowan' is the hireable tavern companion ('human_founder_hero' is Aurora; Rowan is the second hero).

design_constraints.label: DESIGN PROPOSAL
design_constraints.count: 4-6 archetypes per shared-rule guidance; this lane defines 6, mapped to the six skill domains so every domain has a natural owner.
design_constraints.no_routine_permadeath: Archetypes never introduce permanent death on wound/capture; death is out of scope (Lane 4 owns prisoner lifecycle).
design_constraints.deterministic: Starting kits are fixed per archetype id; no RNG.

archetype_table_contract.label: DESIGN PROPOSAL
archetype_table_contract.proposed_struct: FSoulHeroArchetypeDef { FName ArchetypeId; FName PrimaryDomain; FName SecondaryDomain; TMap<FName,int32> StartSkills; TArray<FName> AssignmentFit; }
archetype_table_contract.proposed_table: FSoulHeroArchetypeTable (loaded from Data/, read-only). Keyed hero->archetype mapping lives beside hero candidate data (parallels FSoulHeroCandidate in SoulHeroRecruitment.h).
archetype_table_contract.no_save_impact: Archetype is recomputed from HeroId at load; nothing archetype-specific is serialized. This keeps the Soul.Campaign schema at v1.
